composition.serve_who: This sheet (03 of 25, "PLC INTERFACE", section MAST) is a WAGO I/O rack layout for the MAST hydraulic PLC node. It shows a fieldbus coupler rack (X0) with a CAN gateway, digital/analog I/O modules (00-33), power supply modules, and a bus extension to a second rack (X6-33) via coupler module. This is INFRASTRUCTURE (the rack/bus/PLC backbone itself) — the sheet does not name any specific EV/actuator signals against I/O channels (no signal-name labels like EV-x.y are printed on this sheet), so no individual equipment functions can be composed from this view. All content here (coupler, filter, gateway, DI/AI/DO/AO modules, power supplies, bus extension/end modules) is the mast-PLC rack architecture that will carry signals to mast-area hydraulic equipment (winches, furlers, cylinders) documented on other sheets — but since no channel-to-EV mapping is visible/legible on this sheet, no equipment-specific flow scenarios can be drawn without inventing connections.

infrastructure.system_name: MAST PLC I/O Rack (WAGO fieldbus node, Rack 1)
facts: X0 Fieldbus Coupler 750-362 with CAN Gateway 750-658, DIP-switch address block, Ethernet ports IN/OUT for daisy-chain networking
Position 00-04: DI1-DI4 digital input modules (750-1405 x4) plus one extra 750-1405
X2 Power Supply module 750-602 (feeds DO2/DO3 group)
Positions 09-13: DO2-DO6 digital output modules (750-508 x5)
X3 Power Supply module 750-602 (feeds DO7-DO11 group)
Positions 14-18: DO7-DO11 digital output modules (750-508 x5)
X4 Power Supply module 750-602 (feeds DO12-DO16 group)
Positions 19-23: DO12-DO16 digital output modules (750-508 x5)
X5 Bus Extension End Module 750-627 terminates rack 1 and links via cable to rack 2 coupler X6
Rack is DIN-rail mounted per DIN 34 norm (per sheet note, rights reserved)

infrastructure.system_name: MAST PLC I/O Rack (WAGO fieldbus node, Rack 2 - bus extension)
facts: X6 Bus Extension Coupler Module 750-628 receives extension from Rack 1 X5 end module
Positions 24-28: DO17-DO21 digital output modules (750-508 x5)
X7 Power Supply module 750-602 (feeds DO22-DO25/AO1 group)
Positions 29-32: DO22-DO25 digital output modules (750-508 x4)

uncertainties: No signal names (e.g. EV-x.y hydraulic pilot identifiers, sensor names) are printed against any I/O channel on this sheet, so which specific mast equipment (winches, furlers, cylinders) each DI/DO/AI/AO channel drives cannot be determined from this drawing alone — that mapping must come from a wiring/interconnection sheet not shown here.

Common/reference channel designations for each module (needed to state 'measure relative to common') are not legible/labeled distinctly beyond generic +/- terminal markings; cannot be captured without risking a guess.

Module position count 00-04 shows five DI-type terminals under four labeled DI1-DI4 signal names (750-1405 appears 4x plus initial position 00) - exact channel-to-position correspondence not fully resolved from image alone.
